name: merge-agent-handler
description: Connect Codex to hundreds of enterprise tools (Jira, Salesforce, Slack, Gong, Workday, etc.) via the Merge CLI

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to enterprise tools via Merge
interface.longDescription: Merge Agent Handler gives Codex secure, managed access to hundreds of enterprise applications — Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Gong, Workday, GitHub, NetSuite, and more — through a single integration. The plugin runs the Merge CLI to install, authenticate, and configure access.
